title: Bongo Bananacorno
premise: Bongo forces one absurdly huge corn cob into a tiny smiley bucket, stops the bulging bucket with one huge slam, and triggers a popcorn eruption.

dialogue.delivery: dry, pleased, same voice and pitch

shots.action: A huge corn cob is already jammed into the tiny bucket; Bongo pushes with his whole body until the bucket suddenly slurps it completely inside.
Bongo crouches, raises both arms and performs one forceful double-palm bucket slam with contact, compression, recoil and settle.
A short suspense beat becomes a continuous banana-popcorn eruption that buries Bongo; he emerges and tastes one piece.

generation_policy.primary_model: Veo 3.1 Fast in image-element reference mode
generation_policy.acceptance_rule: Generate two independent variants from Bongo's identity reference, accept the funnier readable motion, and spend a third attempt only on a diagnosed failure.
